correctness.rationale: On D=GP(10,2), a selected subset is total dominating iff OR of its open-neighbor masks is the all-20-vertex mask. Complete independent enumeration of every subset of size 0..8 finds none at 0..7 and exactly 190 at 8, so min=8. Enumerating every selected-to-unselected replacement among 190 optima reconstructs 360 legal jumps and zero slides; degree histogram 40 zeros, 120 fours, 30 eights. Exact connected-component search returns 40 isolates and one 150-vertex component; BFS from every one of 150 vertices gives eccentricity 10. Its degree-4 induced subgraph consists of twenty six-cycles; each of thirty degree-8 vertices neighbors exactly four vertices in each of two distinct hexagons. Quotient pairs are 30 distinct edges, each of 20 hexagons has degree 3. Exact explicit permutation phi=[0,1,3,2,12,11,17,14,13,4,5,18,10,19,9,8,16,15,7,6] sends complete quotient edge set to GP(10,3)=Desargues graph. Source independently enumerates full 120 base automorphisms and five optimal-set orbits (60,60,30,30,10). Fresh independent finite exhaustive GP enumeration reverified quotient and all eccentricities; source also contains independent LCF-model checker. Because finite input and complete enumeration with exact predicates/bijection, this supports the full finite claim rather than a sample.
